class.name: MovementModeTransition
class.brief_description: A rule for leaving one movement mode for another, as an object.
class.description: The point is where the rule lives. A mode that decides its own exits has every such decision written into it, so adding [i]climb a ladder when one is in reach[/i] means editing the walking mode - and then editing it again for the next idea. A transition is authored beside the mode instead, in [member MovementMode.transitions], or globally in [member CharacterMovementComponent.transitions], and the mode it leaves never hears about it. Evaluated after the mode has run, in order: the active mode's own list first, then the component's global one. The first that answers with a name wins, so order is priority.

method.name: _evaluate
method.description: The mode to switch to, or an empty [StringName] for [i]not now[/i]. Called every tick while the mode it belongs to is active, so it should be cheap - and it must not move anything.
